newsitem.title: UK: Uzbekistan plans debut dollar Eurobond -dealers.
newsitem.headline: Uzbekistan plans debut dollar Eurobond -dealers.

text.p: Uzbekistan is planning a debut Eurobond and is taking bids from banks for advice on obtaining credit ratings prior to its launch, traders said on Wednesday.
"There is a beauty parade at the moment and Uzbekistan is looking at four or five banks," a syndicate manager at a European bank told Reuters.
"The mandate will be for ratings and a Eurobond."
Uzbekistan's first international bond issue was expected to be similar in size and maturity to one brought by neighbouring Kazakhstan last year, he said.
Kazakhstan's $200 million three-year bond was launched via ABN AMRO Hoare Govett in December to yield around 350 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
The deal was now trading at a 250 b.p. spread
An Uzbek Eurobond would pay around 150 b.p. over Kazakhstan paper, an analyst at a U.S. bank said.

Kazakhstan was rated Ba3 by Moody's and BB-minus by Standard & Poor's. The S&P rating was the same as that awarded to Russia, but the Moody's rating was slightly below Russia's Ba2 long-term debt rating.
